spec_match.rationale: Targets the proposal's motivating case — stackless samples as unexplainable gaps — with a real 800ms mixed-load session and an attribution score computed from the actual samples' stackId/marker members.

interactive.rationale: Each run profiles fresh, redraws the timeline strip (real sample timestamps mapped to x), and recomputes the verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the timeline with per-sample colouring and a gap-attribution count; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Zero-attribution engines get the honest mystery-gaps verdict with the grey ticks called out; construction failure is caught.

conformance.rationale: Rides the suite's trace-shape and COI assertions; the marked path maps to the manual isolated-run assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP runs: ~80 real samples over ~815ms with ~10 genuine stackless gap samples plotted above the midline and the honest 0-attributed verdict; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: Strip colours come from theme accent variables via getComputedStyle; legend chips bordered; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: The canvas has a descriptive aria-label and the verdict duplicates the strip's meaning in text; legend is aria-hidden decoration; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The strip is width-fluid with DPR-aware drawing; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Show a real attribution percentage on isolated Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On an isolated origin with markers, gc/layout/paint ticks should colour the strip and the score should report the explained percentage — capture that for the before/after narrative.

guidanceConsulted.query: timeline strip tick plot canvas accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Canvas plots need text equivalents and theme-token colours.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: aria-label on the canvas, textual verdict carrying the same counts, colours read from CSS variables at draw time.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Alternate bounded work types per frame.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Script and layout bursts alternate per rAF tick for a fixed 800ms window.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): real mixed-load sessions produced genuine stackless gap samples that the strip plots and the verdict honestly reports as unattributed on Chromium 141 — the exact problem statement of the proposal, demonstrated with live data.
